correction.note:
### Owner-adopted proof erratum

The literal source Proof above is retained unchanged. On printed p. 15 / PDF37 it writes each $a\in A$ as $a=\lambda x_n+b$ with $b\in B$. The owner-adopted corrected reading is
\[
\tag{p. 15, corrected}a=\lambda x_n+c,\qquad\lambda\in\Lambda,\ c\in\Lambda x_1+\cdots+\Lambda x_{n-1},
\]
where $c$ need not lie in $A$. The mapping $a\to\lambda$ still maps $A$ onto an ideal $I$ of $\Lambda$ with kernel $B$, so the exact sequence, the splitting by 2.4 and the induction in the printed proof are unchanged.

The owner adopted this erratum on 2026-11-05, relayed in I-0052. The theorem Statement and other nodes are unchanged. This is not an independent fidelity verdict or a completed formal proof.
